description: Dynamic Island-style living notch for Windows and macOS with synced lyrics, focus timer, file shelf, tasks, clipboard history, and system stats.
notes: Uses the official Windows portable ZIP, not the per-user Setup.exe. The repository's Validate manifest archives workflow downloaded the v0.2.22 ZIP, verified its published SHA-256, and confirmed that Poni\poni.exe exists in the archive.
The application stores user data under %APPDATA%\Poni and cache/log files under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Poni; these paths are outside the Scoop app directory.
The application's own update mechanism is left unchanged.
